The '''Lower Deck''' was a blue-collar [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located in [[Port Town (Cloud City)/Legends|Port Town]], a disreputable part of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. It was owned by [[Brann Lo-Farr]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].
